name: Birdwatcher Catriona

intro.text: Ptarmigan! A grouse that turns white in winter. Snow bunting! A bunting that thinks it's a snowflake. I'm on a list. It's long.

win: My list is a little shorter. And a little less dignified.
after: The ptarmigan changes into three different outfits a year. Brown in summer, white in winter and sort of patchy in-between.
